bank_accounts_holder_one_of.name: bank_accounts_holder_one_of
bank_accounts_holder_one_of.value: ("bank_accounts"."holder_actor_id" IS NOT NULL) <> ("bank_accounts"."holder_name" IS NOT NULL)

properties_money_non_negative.name: properties_money_non_negative
properties_money_non_negative.value:
("properties"."purchase_price_cents" IS NULL OR "properties"."purchase_price_cents" >= 0)
        AND ("properties"."closing_costs_cents" IS NULL OR "properties"."closing_costs_cents" >= 0)
        AND ("properties"."land_value_cents" IS NULL OR "properties"."land_value_cents" >= 0)
        AND ("properties"."fmv_at_conversion_cents" IS NULL OR "properties"."fmv_at_conversion_cents" >= 0)
        AND ("properties"."sale_price_cents" IS NULL OR "properties"."sale_price_cents" >= 0)

properties_sold_after_acquired.name: properties_sold_after_acquired
properties_sold_after_acquired.value: "properties"."sold_date" IS NULL OR "properties"."acquired_date" IS NULL OR "properties"."sold_date" >= "properties"."acquired_date"
